tasks.title: Sign of a number
tasks.statement: Write a function sign(x) that returns the word «positive» for x > 0, «negative» for x < 0, and «zero» for x = 0.
tasks.hint: Three branches: if x > 0: ... elif x < 0: ... else: ...

tasks.title: Is the number even
tasks.statement: Write a function is_even(n) that returns True if n is even and False if it is odd. Hint: the remainder of division is the % operator.
tasks.hint: A comparison gives a bool by itself: return n % 2 == 0.

tasks.title: Maximum of two
tasks.statement: Write a function max2(a, b) that returns the larger of two numbers. You may not use the built-in max() function, only if and else.
tasks.hint: If a > b: return a, otherwise return b. For equal numbers, either branch works, so else will do.

tasks.title: Ticket price
tasks.statement: A cinema sets the price by age: up to and including 7 years old, 0; from 8 to 17 inclusive, 200; from 18 and older, 400. Write a function ticket_price(age) that returns the price.
tasks.hint: Check from the youngest, top to bottom: if age <= 7 ... elif age <= 17 ... else ...
